newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GP Batteries buys Douza for US$4.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: GP Batteries buys Douza for US$4.5 mln.

text.p: Battery maker GP Batteries International Ltd said on Friday it paid US$4.5 million for Douza Investments Ltd, a supplier of carbon conducting foils.

GP Batteries said in a statement the purchase of Douza, one of its key suppliers, was a strategic move to secure a supply of carbon conducting foils. It would "integrate the Group's manufacturing operations and enhance its profitability".

GP said the deal would be financed from internal resources and bank borrowings and was not expected to have a material effect on its earnings or net tangible assets for the year ending March 1997. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703011)
